#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Register slide6.xml in the presentation package registry files."""
from pathlib import Path

base = Path("workspace/unpacked")

# 1. [Content_Types].xml - add Override for the new slide
ct = base / "[Content_Types].xml"
text = ct.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
old = '  <Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide5.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"/>'
new = old + '\n' + '  <Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide6.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"/>'
assert text.count(old) == 1, "slide5 Override not found or duplicated"
text = text.replace(old, new)
ct.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
print("Updated [Content_Types].xml")

# 2. ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels - add relationship for the new slide
rels = base / "ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels"
text = rels.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
old = '  <Relationship Id="rId12" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slide" Target="slides/slide5.xml"/>'
new = old + '\n' + '  <Relationship Id="rId13" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slide" Target="slides/slide6.xml"/>'
assert text.count(old) == 1, "rId12 relationship not found or duplicated"
text = text.replace(old, new)
rels.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
print("Updated ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels")

# 3. ppt/presentation.xml - add slide ID to sldIdLst
pres = base / "ppt/presentation.xml"
text = pres.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
old = '    <p:sldId id="260" r:id="rId12"/>'
new = old + '\n' + '    <p:sldId id="261" r:id="rId13"/>'
assert text.count(old) == 1, "sldId 260 not found or duplicated"
text = text.replace(old, new)
pres.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
print("Updated ppt/presentation.xml")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Structural sanity check of the edited OOXML package (stdlib only)."""
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path

base = Path("workspace/unpacked")

# 1. All XML/rels parts must be well-formed
bad = []
for p in sorted(list(base.rglob("*.xml")) + list(base.rglob("*.rels"))):
    try:
        ET.parse(p)
    except ET.ParseError as e:
        bad.append(f"{p}: {e}")
assert not bad, f"Malformed XML parts: {bad}"
print(f"All {len(list(base.rglob('*.xml')) + list(base.rglob('*.rels')))} XML parts are well-formed")

NS_P = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main"
NS_R = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships"
NS_CT = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types"
NS_PR = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"

# 2. Content_Types declares slide6
ct = ET.parse(base / "[Content_Types].xml").getroot()
overrides = {o.get("PartName") for o in ct.findall(f"{{{NS_CT}}}Override")}
assert "/ppt/slides/slide6.xml" in overrides, "slide6 missing from Content_Types"
print("Content_Types declares /ppt/slides/slide6.xml")

# 3. presentation.xml.rels maps rId13 -> slides/slide6.xml
rels = ET.parse(base / "ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels").getroot()
rel_map = {r.get("Id"): r.get("Target") for r in rels.findall(f"{{{NS_PR}}}Relationship")}
assert rel_map.get("rId13") == "slides/slide6.xml", f"rId13 -> {rel_map.get('rId13')}"
assert rel_map.get("rId12") == "slides/slide5.xml"
print("presentation.xml.rels: rId13 -> slides/slide6.xml")

# 4. presentation.xml sldIdLst includes id 261 -> rId13, in order after 260
pres = ET.parse(base / "ppt/presentation.xml").getroot()
ids = [(s.get("id"), s.get(f"{{{NS_R}}}id")) for s in pres.find(f"{{{NS_P}}}sldIdLst")]
assert ("261", "rId13") == ids[-1], f"last sldId entry wrong: {ids[-1]}"
assert len(ids) == 6, f"expected 6 slides, got {len(ids)}"
assert [i for i, _ in ids] == ["256", "257", "258", "259", "260", "261"]
print("presentation.xml sldIdLst: 6 slides, slide6 last (id 261 / rId13)")

# 5. slide6.xml parses, has ctrTitle placeholder, and its rels point to an existing layout
s6 = ET.parse(base / "ppt/slides/slide6.xml").getroot()
phs = [sp for sp in s6.iter(f"{{{NS_P}}}ph")]
assert any(ph.get("type") == "ctrTitle" for ph in phs), "ctrTitle placeholder missing"
texts = [t.text or "" for t in s6.iter("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main}t")]
assert any("Thank you for your attention" in t for t in texts), "text missing"
print("slide6.xml: ctrTitle placeholder with 'Thank you for your attention'")

s6rels = ET.parse(base / "ppt/slides/_rels/slide6.xml.rels").getroot()
targets = [r.get("Target") for r in s6rels.findall(f"{{{NS_PR}}}Relationship")]
assert targets == ["../slideLayouts/slideLayout1.xml"], targets
assert (base / "ppt/slideLayouts/slideLayout1.xml").exists()
assert "/ppt/slideLayouts/slideLayout1.xml" in overrides
print("slide6 rels: -> slideLayout1.xml (exists and declared)")

# 6. No dangling refs: every slide relationship target exists
for relf in (base / "ppt/slides/_rels").glob("*.rels"):
    for r in ET.parse(relf).getroot().findall(f"{{{NS_PR}}}Relationship"):
        target = (relf.parent.parent / r.get("Target")).resolve()
        assert target.exists(), f"dangling: {relf.name} -> {r.get('Target')}"
print("All slide relationship targets exist")
print("STRUCTURAL CHECK PASSED")
